nameEn: Wholesale of solid, liquid and gaseous fuels and related products
description: This class includes the wholesale of fuels and related products.
includes: wholesale of solid fuels: coal, coke, charcoal, wood fuel
wholesale of liquid fuels: petroleum products, fuel oil, diesel, lubricants
wholesale of gaseous fuels: LPG, natural gas
excludes: retail sale of automotive fuel, see 4730
